legal.draftNotice: Sample text – the owner and a lawyer must review and complete it before publishing.
privacy: We only collect the data needed for the booking: name, phone, email, dog's name and notes.
We use it solely to handle and remind you about your appointment and do not share it with third parties other than the providers needed to run the site (hosting, database, email).
You may request access, correction or deletion of your data by contacting us.
terms: A booking is confirmed via the link sent to your email. Unconfirmed slots are released automatically.
You can cancel online up to 24 hours before the start using the link in your email. After that, please call us.
Payment is made at the studio.
cookies: We only use strictly necessary cookies for the site and the admin panel.
We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

book.q: How do I book an appointment?
book.a: Open “Book now”, choose a service (and your dog's size if needed), a date and a free time. You then receive an email with a confirmation link. Your slot is held for {minutes} minutes until you confirm it.

payment.a: No. You pay at the studio. Nothing is paid online.

cancel.a: Yes – use the cancellation link in your confirmation email, up to {hours} hours before the appointment. To change an appointment or to cancel later, please contact the studio.

price.q: How much does a service cost and how long does it take?
price.a: Price and duration depend on the service and on your dog's size. The Services page lists the price and duration of every service.

noEmail.q: I did not receive the confirmation email. What should I do?
noEmail.a: Check your Spam and Promotions folders. If the email did not arrive and the confirmation time has run out, the slot is released and you can book again.
